    40	        cases = (
    41	            ({"note": None}, {"note": None, "enabled": True}),
    42	            ({"note": ""}, {"note": "", "enabled": True}),
    43	            ({"enabled": False}, {"note": "before", "enabled": False}),

    45	        for update in (patch_settings, update_preferences):
